# SlideBay Task Outline & Design Notes

## Section Structure & Order

1. **Header / Navbar:** Sticky navigation with brand logo, links, and action button.
2. **Hero Carousel:** Full-width high-impact slider with image/content slides, prev/next controls, and indicator dots.
3. **Features Grid:** 3-column feature cards with Lucide icons and hover transitions.
4. **Interactive Showcase / Carousel:** Secondary carousel highlighting key workflows or product modules.
5. **Testimonials Slider:** Client feedback cards with star ratings and author avatars.
6. **Call To Action Banner:** High-contrast conversion banner with newsletter/signup action.
7. **Footer:** Multi-column link directory, copyright, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- **Colors:** Deep indigo primary (`#4f46e5`), vibrant orange accent (`#f97316`), slate neutral palette.
- **Images:** Deterministic Unsplash/Picsum seed placeholders (`https://picsum.photos/seed/slidebay-<n>/800/600`).
- **Typography:** Inter sans-serif font family.
